g.text: LCSS turns graph structure into denoised supervision for graph-free inference

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Training uses the graph only to build label-free contrastive geometry; inference keeps only an X-only MLP.

g.text: Fig. 1 | Local-consensus soft supervision (LCSS). The graph is used only during training to learn label-free GRACE representations and construct local consensus soft targets from noisy

text.style: font-size: 6.25px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1f2937

g.text: training labels. The deployed classifier is an ordinary MLP that takes raw node features only.
